result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but one card shows a loading spinner stuck over an image that has already rendered.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card displays a circular loading spinner centered over its food image even though the image is fully visible behind it, so the loading state appears stuck and obscures the photo.
issues.suggestion: Clear the loading indicator once the image finishes loading, and only show the spinner while the image is actually loading or has failed.
